skill.name: mediabunny

skill.summary: Read audio and video metadata with Mediabunny.
skill.author: remotion-dev

content.value_statement: Media metadata tasks need suitable input sources across browser, Node.js, Bun, and Remotion projects. This skill provides Mediabunny patterns for reading durations and video dimensions from URLs or local files.
actual_capabilities: Reads audio duration in seconds with Mediabunny.
Reads video duration in seconds with Mediabunny.
Returns display width and height for a primary video track.
Shows URL-based media inputs with UrlSource.
Shows FileSource for browser, Node.js, and Bun file inputs.
Shows Remotion staticFile paths for local media assets.
limitations: It covers duration and primary video dimensions only.
It does not transcode, edit, or generate media.
URL access depends on runtime network permissions and source availability.
A video without a primary video track raises an error in the dimensions example.

use_cases.title: Validate media uploads
use_cases.description: A web developer checks audio length and video resolution before accepting an uploaded file.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Remotion composition
use_cases.description: A motion designer reads local asset duration or dimensions before setting composition timing and layout.

use_cases.title: Inspect files in automation
use_cases.description: A Node.js developer extracts basic metadata from local audio and video files during a processing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Read audio duration
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to read the duration of an uploaded audio File with Mediabunny.

prompt_templates.title: Measure a remote video
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to read the duration of a video available at a URL with Mediabunny.

prompt_templates.title: Read Remotion dimensions
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to get width and height for a video in my Remotion public directory.

prompt_templates.title: Create a metadata helper
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable Mediabunny helper that returns audio duration or video duration and dimensions for a local file.

output_examples.input: I need the duration of an audio file selected through a browser upload.
output: Uses FileSource with the uploaded File.
Returns the duration in seconds after Mediabunny reads the input.

output_examples.input: I need the size of a video in a Remotion project.
output: Uses staticFile for the video asset.
Reads display width and height from the primary video track.

output_examples.input: I need the duration of a remote MP4 file.
output: Uses UrlSource with the media URL.
Returns the video duration in seconds.

best_practices: Use FileSource for local browser, Node.js, or Bun file inputs.
Handle missing primary video tracks before reading dimensions.
Check URL availability and runtime network permissions before using UrlSource.
anti_patterns: Do not use UrlSource when the media is already available as a local File.
Do not assume every video has a primary video track.
Do not treat duration and dimensions as a substitute for full media validation.

faq.question: Which runtimes does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers browser, Node.js, Bun, and Remotion usage patterns.

faq.question: Can it read audio duration?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to return audio duration in seconds.

faq.question: Can it read video duration?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to return video duration in seconds.

faq.question: Can it read video dimensions?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads display width and height from the primary video track.

faq.question: Can I use a remote media URL?
faq.answer: Yes. Use UrlSource when the runtime can access the URL.

faq.question: Can it edit or convert media?
faq.answer: No. The documented examples only read media metadata.
